subject: Seller onboarding — payment forms, ACH & wire remittance samples
messages:
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com
To: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@stellarlabs.com>
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Welcome — Redwood vendor onboarding (ACH/wire details needed)

Hi Priya,

Thanks for choosing Redwood — excited to get Stellar Labs set up in our payments system. To get finance to issue POs and remits we need the following from your side:

- Completed W-9 (or W-8 if non‑US)
- A bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account name, routing, account number (signed) OR a voided check
- Preferred payout method (ACH daily, ACH weekly, or wire) and receiving instructions for both ACH and wire (if you accept wire)
- A short example of your remittance format (how you want PO numbers to appear on invoices/remit) — a single sample CSV or screenshot is fine

If you can upload files to a secure link or attach them here, we can start micro‑deposit verification today. Our FinOps team will also ask for one business contact for payment escalations.

Next steps / timeline: once we have the bank letter + W‑9 we run micro‑deposits (T+1), confirm, then create a vendor record and issue the first PO. Typical time to first payment is 3–5 business days after verification.

Please let me know if you have any compliance constraints (e.g., specific KYC redaction requirements). Thanks — I’ll loop Jordan and Marissa into the PO mapping once we have the remittance sample.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf]
From: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@stellarlabs.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: accounts@stellarlabs.com
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Welcome — Redwood vendor onboarding (ACH/wire details needed)

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the clear list. Attaching the requested docs:
- stellarlabs_W9.pdf (signed)
- bank_letter_stellarlabs.pdf (signed by bank officer)

We prefer ACH weekly but can accept wires for expedited payouts. For remittance, our preferred PO mapping is: PO-<vendor_po_number> in the invoice reference field. Attached is a short PDF that shows how our accounting system exports remittance details.

Note: for KYC, we can redact account officer direct lines if needed. Micro‑deposits are fine — please let us know transferred amounts and expected timing.

Priya Mehta
Head of Finance Operations
Stellar Labs, Inc.
[Attachments: stellarlabs_W9.pdf (PDF), bank_letter_stellarlabs.pdf (PDF)]
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com
To: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@stellarlabs.com>
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Welcome — Redwood vendor onboarding (ACH/wire details needed)

Hi Priya — got the W‑9 and bank letter, thank you. A couple quick clarifications before we run micro‑deposits: 

1) Bank letter: can you confirm whether the account number on the letter is a checking account or an ACH clearing account? We typically prefer checking accounts for wire fallback.
2) Remittance sample: the PDF you attached looks good; for our PO mapping we need a one‑line CSV sample with the exact header names your system uses (invoice_id, po_reference, remit_note). Could you export one sample row (fake data OK) and attach as CSV?

If you can provide that CSV and confirm account type we will schedule micro‑deposits this afternoon (expected arrival to your account tomorrow morning PST). Our standard micro‑deposit amounts are two small cents (e.g., $0.12 and $0.41). We will reply with the exact amounts once posted.

Thanks — Jordan will pick up the PO creation after verification; Marissa will confirm remittance label mapping with your AP team.

Regards,
Olga

Hello Olga —

Micro‑deposits posted at 15:30 PST. Screenshot attached (microdeposit_screenshot.png). Amounts were $0.12 and $0.41. Our CSV sample is attached as one row (sample_remit_row.csv) — header row: invoice_id,po_reference,remit_note — sample row uses PO-987654 as the po_reference.

We accept weekly ACH; for urgent wires let us know and we will supply wire beneficiary code.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — please confirm when the vendor record and first PO are created so we can attach invoices with correct PO values.

Best,
Accounts Payable
Stellar Labs, Inc.
[Attachments: microdeposit_screenshot.png, sample_remit_row.csv]
